name: Pushups
description: Maintain a straight body and lower with control.

name: Dips
description: Use stable supports and avoid uncomfortable shoulder positions.

name: Rows
description: Pull elbows back in a controlled motion.

name: Dead bug
description: Alternate opposite arm and leg while keeping your core braced.

name: Leg raises
description: Lift and lower legs slowly without arching your back.

name: Squats
description: Sit back and down with feet planted.

name: Calf raises
description: Rise onto your toes and lower slowly.

name: Chin-ups
description: Pull up with palms facing you, lowering with control.

name: Grips
description: Squeeze and release your grip trainer.

name: 7-second holds
description: Hold the chosen position for seven seconds per repetition.

name: Prone reverse flies
description: Lie facedown, arms out to your sides, gently lift arms in a comfortable range. Stop if tingling or pain occurs.
